name: Knuckle, the Rail-Scent Hound
text: Before rolling movement, spend 1 charge to follow Knuckle's canonical same-reach route to a legal transition sector and stop there. The hound cannot bypass gates, locks, or blockers.
imagePrompt: Original Ashenreach follower portrait of a broad ash-coated tracking hound in a rugged industrial harness with brass scent canisters and an ember route beacon at a broken rail junction, no text or logo.
flavor: Knuckle smells iron paths beneath stone.
